sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The leaders arrive in excellent form with five consecutive wins before a recent draw, so they'll be heavy favourites against bottom-placed Alsager Town, who have won only once all season and are on a five-game losing streak.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town in what could be a significant title-race fixture, with Stafford looking to close the gap on leaders Sandbach following their recent draw. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table and unbeaten in their last five, face a tough away test at Eccleshall (6th place), who themselves have rebounded from a recent loss with winning form. Wolverhampton Casuals entertain Wednesfield Community in a mid-table clash between sides with mixed recent form. Bilston Town (6th) travel to Foley Meir (13th) in another fixture where the higher-placed side will be favoured. In-form Barnton (7th, unbeaten in two) host Shawbury United (15th), who are struggling with five consecutive defeats. Market Drayton Town (10th) face New Mills (8th) in a mid-table encounter, while Brereton Social (11th) welcome struggling Widnes Town (bottom, pointless this season). Crewe host Allscott Heath in a battle between sides near the lower end of the table, and Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a fixture between two of the division's weakest performers this season.
